answer: Peer-attested temporal consistency binds each agent to an unbroken history of verified interactions. Every epoch a random past challenge is replayed and the agent must reconstruct its exact prior response from local state alone. An attacker who spins up many fake identities must either maintain separate full memory stores for each or fail the replay, raising Sybil cost far above any reward. A raven navigating a gale cannot share its flight path, and the ivory seal on each history prevents cheap cloning.
